people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
translations.bsb: So you too must count yourselves dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus.
translations.kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
translations.asv: Even so reckon ye also yourselves to be dead unto sin, but alive unto God in Christ Jesus.
